name: Viridian Forest Catching
objective: Catch Pikachu specifically in Viridian Forest, then navigate through Viridian Forest to the north exit without blacking out.

allowed_randomization.hp_policy: current_hp may vary from 1 to max_hp for at least one conscious Pokemon; some non-lead party members may be fainted.
allowed_randomization.map_policy: Use target-map template states only. Same-map coordinate nudges are allowed. Cross-map WRAM-only teleports are not allowed.
allowed_randomization.story_flags: No story or event flag edits in v0.

valid_start_requirements: State loads through PyBoy and produces an inspectable snapshot.
Player is in Viridian Forest or the Viridian Forest South Gate.
At least one party Pokemon is conscious.
If the start is intended as valid-catching, at least one Poke Ball is present.
impossible_or_degraded_starts: Lead Pokemon has very low HP.
Wild encounter is already active with a risky HP/resource state.
success_conditions: Pikachu is caught and appears in the party.
The player reaches the Viridian Forest north exit or north gate after catching Pikachu.
The player does not black out.
The final state is inspectable and stable.
Accepted safe nickname directives are applied when a nickname prompt occurs.
failure_conditions: No Poke Balls remain and no recoverable route to obtain more is available within budget.
The executor leaves the bounded Viridian/Route 2/Forest area without a recovery reason.
A destructive directive or action is accepted.
abort_conditions: State violates core invariants before the first action.
The evaluator cannot inspect party, inventory, map, or mode.
The state requires unpromoted story/event flags.
evaluator_notes: Route 22 Spearow belongs to the preceding Poke Ball acquisition chapter, not this capsule.
v0 success requires Pikachu ownership/party detection plus forest north-exit navigation.
Automated detection should compare initial and final party species/count once run logs exist.
